scope.summary: Integrate the body viewport per Section 13.27 GUI clauses: reuse the Tailor wgpu viewport with body render pipelines — skin preview shading (SSS approximation) plus heatmap overlay modes for skinning weights, UV strain, and decouple-violations — making validation state visually inspectable in the editor (13.27 validation surfaces in the viewport).
acceptance_criteria: The body renders in the shared Tailor wgpu viewport with a skin preview shading mode (approximated SSS, wet-layer preview hook) at interactive framerate on the bake-level mesh.
Overlay modes switch between: skinning weights (per selected bone), UV strain (MT-570 data), and decouple-violation heatmap (BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID findings painted on the offending vertices).
Overlay state is a typed control with a stable author_id; Argus can switch overlays and capture each mode headlessly.
capture_view (MT-604) works against this viewport including active overlays, so QA captures can show validation heatmaps.
Channel edits reflect in the viewport within one frame batch; no console errors across overlay switches.
scope.risk_if_missed: Validation findings stay abstract numbers — nobody can SEE where a decouple violation or weight problem lives on the body — gutting the inspect-before-verdict loop for the highest-visual-stakes module in the product.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
